config.augmentation: none for all arms; no placement confound
config.purpose: E2 exploratory validation pilot; no final test or powered confirmation
config.selection: mean tuning macro-F1 log-count ALC; two screen banks; independent assessment validation partition; exactly one selected classical family vs analytic map
config.stop: no powered confirmation in this task regardless of result

hyperparameters.normalization: per-coordinate mean/std on this training subset, fixed during learning

limitations: Validation-only exploratory pilot; assessment labels never select checkpoint/family.
Shared small readout differs from historical residual classifier.
Learned convolution is the raw-patch 1-to-16 counterpart, not the historical four-channel learned-stem full network.

quantum.differentiation: torch autograd for readout; frozen feature map
